title: 2006 AMC 12B Problem 6
statement: Francesca uses \(100\) grams of lemon juice, \(100\) grams of sugar, and \(400\) grams of water to make lemonade. There are \(25\) calories in \(100\) grams of lemon juice and \(386\) calories in \(100\) grams of sugar. Water contains no calories. How many calories are in \(200\) grams of her lemonade?

solutions.text:
The full batch weighs \(100 + 100 + 400 = 600\) grams and contains \(25 + 386 = 411\) calories.

Since \(200\) grams is one third of the batch, it has \[\frac{411}{3} = 137\] calories.

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Find the total calories and total grams of the whole batch first
\(200\) grams is one third of the full \(600\)-gram batch
